name: Kamoku na Imouto
source:
The protagonist moves away from home, and spends every day keeping very busy.  He works so much that his studies are beginning to slip, and he spends his free time blowing off some steam with his beloved eroge collection.

One day, the doorbell rings - suddenly, the protagonist's little sister has come to visit! She can't bear to see her beloved brother's room looking such a mess, so she gets to cleaning, and she wipes out his porn collection in one fell swoop.

Unable to masturbate, the protagonist's mind starts to warp, and soon he's got his pervy sights set on taking his sister for himself!

有一天，门铃响了——突然，主角的妹妹来拜访了！她不忍心看到自己心爱的哥哥的房间变得如此狼藉，于是她开始打扫卫生，一举把他的色情收藏全部抹掉了。
